r13_contract.comparisonModel: The Ice Class Regulations of 2002 (20.9.2002 No. 5/30/2002), issued by the Finnish Maritime Administration, as amended, apply to ships the keels of which have been laid or which have been at a similar stage of construction on or after 1 September 2003 but which have been contracted for construction before 1 January 2010.

test_cases.rationale: Applicable construction-stage cohort and pre-2010 contract use the 2002 edition.
Later construction stage with pre-2010 contract remains in the 2002 edition cohort.
Earlier construction stage does not claim the 2002 edition.
Contract at 2010-01-01 is outside the 2002-edition cohort.
Applicable cohort claims the wrong edition.
Pre-2003 construction stage incorrectly claims the 2002 edition.
Post-cohort contract incorrectly claims the 2002 edition.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
